description: This file contains the implementation of the LengthClass model for the Opencart system, providing methods to add, edit, delete, retrieve, and manage length class data and descriptions in the database.

classes.name: LengthClass
classes.description: Model class for managing length units and descriptions, including CRUD operations and retrieval methods.

methods.name: addLengthClass
methods.description: Inserts a new length class and its descriptions into the database, then clears related cache.

methods.name: editLengthClass
methods.description: Updates an existing length class and its descriptions, invalidating cache afterwards.

methods.name: deleteLengthClass
methods.description: Removes a length class and its associated descriptions from the database, clearing cache.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific length class.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all length class descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getLengthClass
methods.description: Retrieves a specific length class and its description for the current language.

methods.name: getLengthClasses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of length classes with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLengthClasses
methods.description: Returns the total number of length classes.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a given length class.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all length class descriptions for a specific language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionByUnit
methods.description: Retrieves a length class description based on the unit and current language.
